purpose: v0.28.0 r8 frozen query-facet specification. Semantics are unchanged from v0.9.12; r8 clarifies that Q11 classical-myth source/retelling evidence and explicit supernatural mythic narrative content may be distributed across multiple supplied description spans and should be composed at full-description component assembly. Analytical legend-origin/provenance prose remains excluded. v0.29 r1 incorporates three adjudicated consumed-final-evidence boundaries: paired self-awakening plus explicit life-direction framing may establish Q03 finding purpose; Q04 dangerous-journey movement requires text-local travel/movement; Q09 missing resistance is handled by deterministic scoring as partial-at-best. v0.29 r2 clarifies Q04 cross-span explicit movement composition and Q09 same-span opposition-plus-authoritarian resistance grounding.
authoring_guidelines: Derive facet structure and semantics from the user query. During development, validation failures may motivate generic boundary clarifications, but never encode candidate-specific facts, titles, authors, human labels, or judge outputs into a facet definition.
Use facet_type='core' for central semantic requirements whose absence materially weakens relevance.
Use facet_type='qualifier' for important modifiers such as beginner-friendly, historical, moving, or thoughtful.
Merge redundant or near-synonymous wording instead of creating duplicate facets.
Keep each facet text concise and semantically self-contained.
Do not split a single relational concept into independent facets when those pieces could be satisfied by unrelated parts of a description.
Use stable facet IDs F1, F2, F3, ... within each query.
Each query must contain at least one core facet.
Do not change frozen facet definitions during a judge run; version the file when definitions change.

Each facet must include a semantic_definition grounded in the query context. It should clarify what counts and important nearby concepts that do not; any calibration-driven clarification must remain generic and reusable across unseen candidates.
The LLM evaluates facet support only; deterministic Python computes the final 0-4 score.
A concept used only as an example, analytical category, instructional illustration, background cause, or contextual factor is not automatically substantive subject matter of the book.
Necessary entailment must not introduce a new target entity, theme, event, or relationship merely because the evidence could symbolize, represent, or be associated with it.
Every facet must define one or more canonical required_components. The verifier may assess those components but may not rename, omit, add, or substitute them.

Each required component has a stable component_id, a generic definition, and optional generic negative boundaries. Component boundaries must not encode candidate titles, case IDs, human labels, or observed judge outputs.

facet_types.core: A central semantic requirement of the query. Core facets determine the base relevance score.
facet_types.qualifier: An important modifier or constraint. Qualifiers can prevent a perfect score when weak or absent, but cannot promote weak core relevance.

queries.query: A story about forgiveness and redemption

facets.semantic_definition: Forgiving a person or oneself for a wrong, hurt, betrayal, or offense, including pardoning, releasing blame or resentment, extending mercy, or choosing reconciliation after wrongdoing. General adaptation, healing, commitment, or personal growth without a wrong being forgiven does not establish forgiveness.

required_components.definition: A wrong, hurt, betrayal, offense, blame, resentment, or other interpersonal/self-directed basis for forgiveness is established.
negative_boundaries: General hardship, adaptation, healing, commitment, or growth without a wrong/hurt/offense does not establish this component.

required_components.definition: Forgiving, pardoning, releasing blame or resentment, extending mercy, or reconciliation after the wrong/hurt/offense is established.
negative_boundaries: Healing or recovery alone is not a forgiveness act.

facets.semantic_definition: Moral, personal, or relational restoration after wrongdoing, failure, corruption, guilt, or a damaged state, including atonement, being redeemed, or regaining worth or a relationship. Generic self-improvement, recovery, learning, adapting to change, escaping hardship, or a generic fall-and-rise from despair/failure to later success or greatness does not establish redemption. Positive grounding must connect the restoration to a redemption-type damaged state rather than merely showing improvement after adversity. Directional transition away from a negative condition—such as finding a way out, escaping, leaving behind, or moving beyond it—does not by itself establish restoration or atonement unless the supplied text also establishes the restorative moral, personal, or relational state or explicitly frames the transition as redemption, atonement, reconciliation, regained worth/standing, or restoration.

required_components.definition: Wrongdoing, moral/personal/relational failure, corruption, guilt, loss of worth, or another damaged moral, personal, or relational state in the redemption sense is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic hardship, despair, adversity, setback, defeat, low status, or a neutral need for improvement does not by itself establish a redemption-type damaged state.

A character merely falling from success/greatness into difficulty or despair is not sufficient unless the supplied text links that condition to wrongdoing, guilt, corruption, damaged worth, or a comparably redemption-relevant personal/relational failure.

required_components.definition: Moral, personal, or relational restoration, atonement, reconciliation, regaining worth/standing, or restoration of the redemption-type damaged relationship/state is established. Merely moving away from a negative condition does not itself establish the restorative state.
negative_boundaries: Generic recovery, sobriety, self-improvement, learning, healing, adaptation, renewed success, or return to greatness alone does not establish redemption.
A fall-and-rise arc establishes this component only when the supplied text connects the later restoration to the redemption-type damaged state rather than merely showing improvement after adversity.

Directional transition language such as finding a way out, escaping, leaving behind, overcoming, or moving beyond a negative condition does not by itself establish restoration/atonement; the supplied text must also establish what moral, personal, or relational standing/state is restored or explicitly frame the transition as redemption, atonement, reconciliation, regained worth/standing, or restoration.

queries.query: A suspenseful story involving crime and investigation

facets.semantic_definition: Sustained narrative tension, anticipation, threat, mystery, pursuit, concealment, or uncertainty about how unfolding events will resolve, presented as an important reading experience. A difficult personal choice, moral dilemma, illness, deadline, interpersonal conflict, battle, rebellion, betrayal, a threatening antagonist, action, danger, high stakes, caregiving dilemma, or generic uncertainty does not by itself establish suspense. The evidence must indicate story-level tension or anticipation about what will happen, be discovered, be escaped, or be resolved; merely describing dangerous/action-packed events or consequential conflict is insufficient. Future-tense plot progression or a statement that actions will trigger, cause, attract, ignite, or set in motion later conflict/consequences does not itself establish suspense; do not add an unstated reader experience of anticipation merely because those future events are dangerous or consequential. A rhetorical or future interpersonal disclosure (for example whether a friendship or relationship will survive when someone learns a truth, secret, obsession, affair, or feelings) does not by itself establish suspense unless the supplied description independently establishes story-level tension through threat, pursuit, mystery/investigation, escape, danger, concealment under threat, or a comparable unresolved development.

hard_exclusions.rule: A difficult, important, consequential, emotional, moral, or caregiving choice does not by itself establish suspense, even when the outcome is unresolved, the alternatives have high stakes, or the decision drives the plot. Uncertainty over which option the character will choose is decision uncertainty, not story-level suspense.
Illness, an outbreak, caregiving stakes, concern for a sick person, or a choice about caring for that person does not by itself establish suspense.

High stakes, danger, a deadline, interpersonal conflict, or generic uncertainty by itself does not establish story-level suspense; the evidence must establish sustained narrative tension or anticipation about what will happen, be discovered, escaped, or resolved.

Action, battle, rebellion, betrayal, military conflict, a dangerous antagonist, or high-stakes confrontation does not by itself establish suspense. The supplied text must independently establish story-level tension or anticipation about an unfolding threat, pursuit, concealment, mystery, discovery, escape, or comparable unresolved development.

required_components.definition: The description establishes story-level tension or anticipation about an unfolding event or outcome, such as an unresolved threat, pursuit, concealment, mystery, impending danger, discovery, escape, or another tension-producing development. Action, battle, rebellion, betrayal, a threatening antagonist, high stakes, or future plot consequences alone are not this component.
negative_boundaries: A difficult personal choice or moral dilemma remains a personal choice even when it is important, consequential, emotional, or high-stakes.
Caregiving stakes, illness, an outbreak, concern for a sick person, or choosing between caregiving and another responsibility do not by themselves establish story-level suspense.
The fact that the outcome of a choice is not yet known, or that the character must decide whether to choose one option or another, is decision uncertainty rather than narrative suspense.

A decision driving the plot does not by itself establish suspense. Positive grounding requires an independently tension-producing unfolding event or outcome such as threat, pursuit, concealment, mystery, impending danger, discovery, escape, or comparable narrative anticipation.

Action-packed events, battle, rebellion, betrayal, military conflict, a threatening antagonist, or danger alone do not establish story-level suspense unless the text also establishes tension/anticipation about an unfolding unresolved development.

Future-tense plot progression or wording that actions will trigger, cause, attract, ignite, or set in motion later conflict, danger, betrayal, confrontation, or other consequences does not by itself establish tension/anticipation. Do not infer suspense merely because a reader could wonder how those consequential events will unfold.
A future/rhetorical relationship consequence caused by learning a truth or secret is interpersonal disclosure uncertainty, not story-level suspense by itself.

facets.semantic_definition: Criminal acts, offenses, perpetrators, victims, or criminal conduct. Concrete acts such as murder, theft, assault, or other illegal wrongdoing can directly establish this facet even when the word 'crime' is absent.

required_components.definition: A criminal act, offense, perpetrator/victim relation, or concrete illegal wrongdoing is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic conflict, harm, danger, or unethical conduct is not automatically criminal conduct.

facets.semantic_definition: A deliberate effort to discover facts, solve a mystery or crime, determine a cause, or identify responsibility, such as detectives, police, or other actors examining evidence or pursuing answers. A suspicious event, death, injury, mystery, or unanswered question alone does not establish that an investigation occurs.

required_components.definition: An actor deliberately examines evidence, pursues clues/answers, determines a cause, solves a mystery/crime, or identifies responsibility.
negative_boundaries: A suspicious event, death, injury, mystery, or unanswered question alone does not establish an investigation.

queries.query: A book about personal growth and finding purpose

facets.semantic_definition: Meaningful self-development or improvement in mindset, abilities, habits, self-understanding, confidence, behavior, effectiveness, maturity, or comparable personal growth. Positive evidence has TWO INDEPENDENTLY SUFFICIENT grounding modes. MODE A — experienced development: the evidence states or necessarily entails that a person develops, improves, matures, transforms, changes behavior/mindset/ability, or gains self-understanding. MODE B — explicitly promoted development: the evidence explicitly states that a practice, activity, path, program, guidance, or subject promotes, develops, cultivates, fosters, builds, or leads to maturity or personal growth in its intended participants, readers, students, children, young people, or other described people. Either Mode A OR Mode B is sufficient. Mode B does NOT require evidence that a named individual has already completed or experienced the development. For example, an explicit statement that a path “promotes maturity and growth” establishes personal growth through Mode B; do not reject it merely because the wording is prospective, instructional, promotional, aspirational, or describes an intended effect. The developing person need not be the author. Merely discussing prayer, faith, spirituality, devotion, philosophy, character, virtues, wisdom, inner peace, or knowing a deity more deeply does not establish personal growth when maturity/development/growth itself is not independently stated or necessarily entailed. Discovering how a deity, belief system, or external force works in or through someone is spiritual interpretation, not self-understanding for this facet. Do not infer growth merely because a spiritual practice or insight could plausibly lead to it. Happiness, enlightenment, wellbeing, inner peace, beneficial life effects, or the potential for such outcomes do not by themselves establish personal growth. Positive effects on health, relationships, career, or other life domains establish this facet only when the supplied text independently states or necessarily entails development, transformation, maturity, changed behavior/mindset/ability, or self-understanding; do not convert generic benefits or spiritual realization into growth by interpretation. Generic intellectual learning, becoming more knowledgeable or wiser, philosophical education/exploration, or wording such as “begin to learn” or “wising up” does not by itself establish personal growth. Such evidence needs an independent development anchor such as growth, maturity, transformation, changed mindset/behavior/ability, confidence, habits, skills, or self-understanding.

required_components.definition: TWO INDEPENDENTLY SUFFICIENT POSITIVE MODES apply to this component. MODE A — experienced development: a person actually develops, improves, matures, transforms, changes behavior/mindset/ability, or gains self-understanding. MODE B — explicitly promoted development: the evidence explicitly says that a practice, activity, path, program, guidance, or subject promotes, develops, cultivates, fosters, builds, or leads to maturity or personal growth in intended participants/readers/students/children/young people or another described population. Either mode establishes this component. Under Mode B, DO NOT require proof that a named individual has already completed or experienced the development. An explicit statement such as “promotes maturity and growth” directly establishes Mode B even when the language is prospective, instructional, promotional, aspirational, or describes an intended effect. The developing person need not be the author.
negative_boundaries: Prayer, faith, spirituality, devotion, philosophy, virtues, wisdom, inner peace, or understanding a deity/external force does not by itself establish personal growth when maturity/development/growth itself is not independently stated or necessarily entailed.

Do not infer growth merely because a practice or insight could plausibly lead to development when no growth, maturity, development, transformation, or self-understanding is actually stated or necessarily entailed.

Do not reject Mode B merely because its wording is prospective, instructional, promotional, aspirational, or describes an intended effect; explicit promotion of maturity or personal growth is itself sufficient evidence for Mode B.

Do not reject explicit maturity or personal-growth language merely because it applies to readers, participants, students, children, young people, or another described population rather than to the authors themselves.

Potential for happiness, enlightenment, wellbeing, inner peace, or positive effects on health, relationships, career, or other life domains does not by itself establish self-development or self-understanding; a generic benefit is not a development event.
If the rationale must say the evidence could, might, possibly, plausibly, or can be interpreted as contributing to growth, the component is not necessarily entailed and must remain missing.

Generic intellectual learning, becoming more knowledgeable or wiser, philosophical education/exploration, or merely “beginning to learn” / “wising up” does not by itself establish personal growth without an independent development, maturity, transformation, mindset/behavior/ability, confidence, habit, skill, or self-understanding anchor.

facets.semantic_definition: Discovering or clarifying meaning, life direction, vocation, calling, values that guide life choices, life goals, or what one truly wants from life. Prayer, faith, spirituality, devotion, knowing a deity more deeply, or discovering how a deity, belief system, external force, or circumstance works in or through someone does not by itself establish finding purpose. The exact evidence must independently connect the person to meaning, life direction, vocation or calling, goals, or values that guide life choices. Do not infer that spiritual understanding, discovery, or devotion supplies purpose merely because it could plausibly lead to meaning or direction. Generic success, achievement, productivity, self-mastery, or discovery alone does not establish finding purpose. A narrow paired positive mode also applies when the supplied description explicitly frames self-awakening or self-discovery together with how to live one's greatest, best, truest, or meaningful life. The pair can establish life-direction/purpose even when the word 'purpose' is absent. Either signal alone remains insufficient, and generic happiness, prosperity, inner peace, success, or spiritual realization alone remains insufficient.

required_components.definition: The person discovers or clarifies meaning, life direction, vocation/calling, guiding values, goals, or what they truly want from life. A paired explicit self-awakening/self-discovery signal plus explicit greatest/best/truest/meaningful-life framing is also sufficient.
negative_boundaries: Spiritual understanding, generic discovery, success, productivity, achievement, or self-mastery alone does not establish purpose.
Self-awakening/self-discovery alone, or greatest/best-life marketing alone, is insufficient; the paired signals are required for this narrow positive mode.

queries.query: A fantasy adventure involving magic and dangerous journeys

facets.semantic_definition: An adventure, quest, journey, or action-driven set of exploits occurring in a fantasy or supernatural setting. A fantasy setting without adventure, or an ordinary adventure without a fantasy element, does not fully establish this composite facet. Movement between fantastical worlds or places combined with an explicit threat, danger, quest-like problem, or action-driving conflict in the same described scenario can entail fantasy adventure even when the word 'adventure' is absent.

required_components.definition: The relevant adventure/exploits occur in a fantasy or supernatural setting/world.
negative_boundaries: An ordinary real-world setting does not satisfy this component.

required_components.definition: An adventure, quest, journey, or action-driven sequence/set of exploits is established. A travel account centered on the named subject's encounters across multiple stated places can entail a journey/adventure when the text itself presents those encounters as the travel narrative; this does not require outside knowledge.
negative_boundaries: A static fantasy setting or isolated conflict without adventure-like progression does not satisfy this component.
Do not reject textually established travel merely because the same span says "encounters" rather than repeating the word "journey"; ordinary text-licensed entailment remains allowed.

facets.semantic_definition: Supernatural or magical powers, spells, enchantment, magical abilities, or other phenomena explicitly presented as magic or an unmistakable magical equivalent.

required_components.definition: Magic, spells, enchantment, magical powers/abilities, or an unmistakable magical equivalent is explicitly established.
negative_boundaries: Generic supernatural atmosphere or unexplained strangeness is insufficient unless it unmistakably constitutes magic.

facets.semantic_definition: Travel, a quest, expedition, voyage, or movement through places that is dangerous, perilous, hazardous, or threatening. General danger, conflict, intrigue, or peril without a journey or travel component does not establish dangerous journeys. Explicit movement or travel between places or worlds plus explicit danger or threat in the same described scenario can entail dangerous journeys even when the movement and danger are stated in different clauses of one span. Explicit movement/travel and danger may occur in different exact description spans, provided each component is independently grounded.

required_components.definition: The relevant subject actually travels, journeys, moves through places/worlds, undertakes a quest, expedition, or voyage. A description that explicitly presents the work as a travel account/book and describes the named subject across multiple stated places can entail actual movement/travel without requiring a separate verb such as "travels".
negative_boundaries: Being trapped, stranded, located, surrounded, threatened, pursued, or rescued in a place does not establish the subject's movement or travel.
A pursuer being "on someone's trail" establishes pursuit, not necessarily movement by the pursued subject.
A rescue situation does not by itself create a quest or journey.
The location-is-not-movement guard does not override explicit travel framing plus a multi-place itinerary/encounter structure stated in the text.

Temporal progression, narrative sequencing such as 'onwards from there', events spanning years, or metaphorical from-X-to-Y progression does not establish actual movement/travel without a text-local movement anchor.

required_components.definition: The movement/travel is dangerous, perilous, hazardous, or threatening. An explicitly shipwrecked named traveler in the same supplied travel narrative establishes a hazard/danger cue associated with the journey without requiring outside knowledge.
negative_boundaries: Travel without danger does not satisfy this component.
Being explicitly shipwrecked in the supplied travel narrative is a danger/hazard cue; do not reject it merely because the word "danger" is absent.

queries.query: A historical book about war and political conflict

facets.semantic_definition: War or warfare can be established in either of two text-grounded ways: (A) sustained armed conflict or clearly established warfare involving organized belligerent sides, military forces, nations, armies, rebel forces, battles, or campaigns; or (B) the supplied description explicitly presents war, wars, or warfare as a meaningful historical/analytical subject being studied, explained, interpreted, strategized about, or examined for causes/effects. Mere background mention of an approaching war, terrorism, murder, mercenary activity, assassination, organized crime, a violent mission, generic conflict, activism, danger, or political tension does not by itself establish war.

hard_exclusions.rule: Terrorism or a terrorist cell, murder or mayhem, mercenary activity, an FBI/security operation, assassination or attack, organized crime, or a dangerous violent mission does not by itself establish war or warfare.

required_components.definition: Either MODE A—actual organized armed conflict/warfare is established—or MODE B—the supplied text explicitly makes war, wars, or warfare itself a meaningful historical/analytical subject (for example history, analysis, explanation, strategy, causes, effects, or preservation/avoidance of war). Either mode is sufficient.
negative_boundaries: Terrorism, murder, mayhem, mercenary activity, assassination, security operations, organized crime, violent missions, generic conflict, or political tension alone do not establish war.

A war that is merely approaching, presaged, named as distant background, or used only as temporal/contextual setting does not establish MODE B unless the description says the work meaningfully studies, analyzes, explains, portrays, or is about war/warfare itself.

facets.semantic_definition: Conflict or struggle over political power, governance, ideology, policy, state authority, or organized political factions. The description must establish an actual political struggle or political motive/goal, not merely actors that can sometimes exist in political conflicts. General discussion of politics, history, activism, terrorism, policing, security operations, personal conflict, or violence without evidence of the political struggle itself does not establish political conflict.

hard_exclusions.rule: A terrorist cell, FBI/police/security involvement, infiltration, murder, mayhem, or violence does not by itself establish political conflict. Political conflict requires supplied evidence of struggle over political power, governance, ideology, policy, state authority, or explicitly political factions or motives.

required_components.definition: The dispute concerns political power, governance, ideology, policy, state authority, or organized political factions. Explicit struggle over the survival, collapse, overthrow, or end of a regime, empire, government, or state order establishes a political-power/state-authority stake when that relation is stated in the text.
negative_boundaries: Politics-adjacent actors or institutions alone do not establish this stake.

required_components.definition: An actual conflict, struggle, contest, opposition, or politically motivated clash over that political stake is established. Revolution, revolutionary violence, an uprising/commune, overthrow, or an explicit contest causing the end/collapse of a regime can establish the actual political struggle when the supplied text links those events to the political stake.
negative_boundaries: General political discussion, history, activism, policing, security operations, or violence without the political struggle itself is insufficient.

facets.semantic_definition: A meaningful focus on past historical events, eras, figures, societies, or historical analysis/context. Merely being an older book or being published near a historical event does not by itself make the described content historical.

required_components.definition: Past historical events, eras, figures, societies, or historical analysis/context are a meaningful focus.
negative_boundaries: Being an older book or being published near a historical event does not establish historical content.

queries.query: A moving story about grief, loss, and learning to live again

facets.semantic_definition: The emotional experience of mourning or deep sorrow caused by a significant loss, especially bereavement. General sadness, hardship, or distress without a significant loss does not by itself establish grief. War trauma, combat wounds, injury, horrors of war, or trauma recovery do not substitute for an unstated grief/significant-loss event.

required_components.definition: A significant loss, especially death/bereavement or another major deprivation/ending, is established.
negative_boundaries: General hardship, danger, illness, bullying, stress, or life change without significant loss does not satisfy this component.
War trauma, wounds, injury, or horrors of war without an actual stated death/bereavement/separation/disappearance/major deprivation do not establish significant loss.

required_components.definition: The emotional experience of mourning or deep sorrow caused by that significant loss is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic distress or sadness not connected to a significant loss does not satisfy this component.

facets.semantic_definition: A significant deprivation or ending such as death, bereavement, separation, disappearance, or the loss of an important relationship, person, role, or part of life. War trauma, combat wounds, injury, horrors of war, or trauma recovery do not substitute for an unstated grief/significant-loss event.

required_components.definition: An actual significant deprivation or ending such as death, bereavement, separation, disappearance, or loss of an important person, relationship, role, or part of life is established.
negative_boundaries: Metaphorical, nostalgic, historical, or descriptive phrases such as "lost time", "lost place", "lost world", "lost past", memory, or reclaiming the past do not by themselves establish a personal significant deprivation.
Trauma, war, wounds, injury, or suffering are not themselves the loss facet unless an actual significant deprivation/ending is stated.

facets.semantic_definition: Rebuilding, resuming, or finding a way to continue life after grief or major loss, including recovery, renewed engagement with life, or learning how to live after what was lost. Generic recovery from an unrelated difficulty does not establish this facet. War trauma, combat wounds, injury, horrors of war, or trauma recovery do not substitute for an unstated grief/significant-loss event.

required_components.definition: Grief or a major/significant loss that precedes and motivates the recovery/rebuilding is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic difficulty, change, recovery, or a new direction without grief/major loss does not satisfy this component.
Remembering or reconstructing history/family memories does not itself establish personal major loss.
Healing from war/trauma or creating something worth living for does not establish this prerequisite unless grief or major loss is independently stated.

required_components.definition: The affected person rebuilds, resumes, renews engagement with, or finds a way to continue their own life after that grief/loss.
negative_boundaries: Reconstructing history, reconstructing another person's former life, remembering family history, reclaiming the past, or generic change/recovery does not establish rebuilding one's own life after loss.

facets.semantic_definition: Emotionally affecting, poignant, touching, or deeply felt presentation likely to move the reader. Merely describing sad subject matter does not necessarily establish that the work is moving.

required_components.definition: The presentation itself is emotionally affecting, poignant, touching, or deeply felt in a way reasonably likely to move a reader.
negative_boundaries: Merely describing sad, tragic, dangerous, or difficult subject matter without affective presentation does not satisfy this component.
Explicit reader-response wording is not required when the language itself strongly conveys poignancy or emotional impact.

queries.query: A story about a complicated relationship between a parent and child

facets.semantic_definition: A parent-child relationship characterized by meaningful tension, distance, conflict, misunderstanding, unresolved issues, emotional complexity, separation, or other difficult dynamics. Explicit parental opposition, approval, rejection, control, estrangement, or another relational stance directed toward an identified child or toward a member of a couple can establish the parent-child relationship even when that person is simultaneously described in a marriage or romantic relationship. The mere presence of a parent and child, a letter, or ordinary family interaction does not establish that the relationship is complicated.

required_components.definition: The relationship being evaluated is actually between a parent and child. This may be directly named, or necessarily entailed by explicit parental action/opposition/approval/rejection directed at an identified person who is the parents' child, including a member of a simultaneously described couple.
negative_boundaries: A marriage, romantic relationship, friendship, sibling relationship, or generic relationship cannot be substituted for a parent-child relationship by analogy.
Do not mistake a simultaneous marriage or romantic relationship for the relationship being tested: the same person may separately be a spouse/partner and a child of the opposing or approving parents.

required_components.definition: That parent-child relationship has meaningful tension, distance, conflict, misunderstanding, unresolved issues, emotional complexity, separation, or another difficult dynamic.
negative_boundaries: Mere presence of a parent and child, a letter, or ordinary family interaction does not establish a complicated dynamic.

queries.query: A beginner-friendly book explaining astronomy and the universe

facets.semantic_definition: Astronomy, cosmology, space, or the universe, including celestial objects, the origin or structure of the cosmos, and cosmological phenomena such as stars, galaxies, black holes, the Big Bang, wormholes, or related space-time topics. Concrete cosmological phenomena can establish this facet even when the words 'astronomy' or 'universe' are absent.

required_components.definition: Astronomy, cosmology, space, the universe, celestial objects, cosmic origins/structure, or concrete cosmological phenomena are established.
negative_boundaries: Generic physics/science without astronomy/cosmology/space content does not automatically satisfy this component.

facets.semantic_definition: An explanation intended to be accessible to beginners or general readers, including introductory, clear, simple, everyday-language, step-by-step, or otherwise explicitly accessible treatment. Technical content, visualization, or critical-thinking emphasis alone does not establish beginner-friendliness.

required_components.definition: The treatment is explicitly introductory, beginner-friendly, clear/simple, everyday-language, step-by-step, or otherwise accessible to general readers.
negative_boundaries: Technical content, visualization, or critical-thinking emphasis alone does not establish beginner-friendliness.

queries.query: A dystopian story about authoritarian control and resistance

facets.semantic_definition: Oppressive or concentrated institutional or state control over people, such as coercion, censorship, surveillance, repression, enforced obedience, or systematic restriction of freedom. Government, political leadership, influence, or strong authority alone does not establish authoritarian control.

required_components.definition: Institutional, governmental, state, or similarly concentrated authority controls people or society.
negative_boundaries: Leadership, influence, or ordinary government authority alone does not satisfy this component.

required_components.definition: That control is oppressive/coercive, involving censorship, surveillance, repression, enforced obedience, or systematic restriction of freedom.
negative_boundaries: Strong authority without coercive or oppressive restriction is insufficient.

facets.semantic_definition: Active opposition, defiance, rebellion, protest, or struggle against authoritarian or oppressive power. Imprisonment, suffering, eventual freedom, or political involvement alone does not establish resistance unless opposition itself is described or unmistakably instantiated. A same-span explicit opposition action such as overthrow/rebellion plus explicit authoritarian, totalitarian, oppressive, tyrannical, or dictatorial framing can unmistakably instantiate resistance.

required_components.definition: Active opposition, defiance, rebellion, protest, or struggle is established by supplied text. A political label, radical identity, or membership in a named movement/organization alone does not establish active opposition when no oppositional action is stated or necessarily entailed by the description itself.
negative_boundaries: Suffering, imprisonment, political involvement, or eventual freedom alone does not establish resistance.

Do not infer a named movement or person's historical actions from outside knowledge; political identity or membership alone is insufficient when the supplied text does not state opposition/defiance/protest/rebellion/struggle.

required_components.definition: The opposition is directed against authoritarian, oppressive, coercive, or systematically controlling power.
negative_boundaries: Generic conflict or opposition unrelated to oppressive power does not satisfy this component.

Do not infer the target, ideology, or historical adversary of a named political movement, organization, faction, or person from outside knowledge. The supplied description itself must establish that the opposition is directed at authoritarian, oppressive, coercive, or systematically controlling power.

facets.semantic_definition: A fictional society or world characterized by systemic oppression, dehumanization, severe social control, or another bleak and dysfunctional social order typical of dystopian fiction. Generic danger, corruption, darkness, or political trouble alone does not establish a dystopian society.

required_components.definition: A fictional society, social order, or world is established.
negative_boundaries: A real historical/political setting alone is not automatically dystopian fiction.

required_components.definition: The society/world is characterized by systemic oppression, dehumanization, severe social control, or another bleak dysfunctional social order typical of dystopian fiction.
negative_boundaries: Generic danger, corruption, darkness, or political trouble alone does not satisfy this component.

queries.query: A book about leadership, teamwork, and building effective organizations

facets.semantic_definition: Leading, guiding, directing, or influencing people or organizations, including leadership practice, leadership principles, or development of leaders. Generic personal effectiveness, success, or productivity does not by itself establish leadership.

required_components.definition: Leading, guiding, directing, influencing people/organizations, leadership principles/practice, or development of leaders is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic personal effectiveness, success, or productivity alone does not establish leadership.

facets.semantic_definition: People collaborating, coordinating, cooperating, or functioning collectively toward a shared goal. General interpersonal skills, relationships, professional effectiveness, or individual habits do not by themselves establish teamwork.

required_components.definition: People collaborate, coordinate, cooperate, or function collectively toward a shared goal.
negative_boundaries: General interpersonal skills, relationships, professional effectiveness, or individual habits alone do not establish teamwork.

facets.semantic_definition: Designing, managing, improving, or developing organizations so they function effectively, including organizational structure, culture, management systems, processes, or collective performance. Individual effectiveness or leadership alone does not establish building effective organizations. Explicitly solving organizational silos, barriers, politics, infighting, or related dysfunction—and transforming those conditions toward clarity, alignment, productivity, goal achievement, or collective performance—is positive organization-level improvement evidence.

required_components.definition: The content concerns designing, managing, improving, or developing an organization through structure, culture, management systems, processes, or collective performance. This includes interventions that address organizational silos/barriers/politics/infighting or transform organizational dysfunction into improved coordination/alignment.
negative_boundaries: Individual effectiveness or leadership alone does not establish organizational building.

required_components.definition: The organizational work is connected to making the organization function effectively or improving collective organizational performance. Explicit productivity, corporate/organizational goal achievement, clarity, alignment, or collective-performance outcomes tied to solving organizational dysfunction satisfy this component.
negative_boundaries: Describing an organization without an effectiveness/improvement dimension does not fully establish this facet.

queries.query: An adventure inspired by mythology, gods, and legendary heroes

facets.semantic_definition: A quest, journey, expedition, or action-driven sequence of exploits involving challenge, discovery, or danger. A static fantasy setting or isolated conflict without an adventure-like progression does not necessarily establish adventure. A quest, journey, or adventure term used only as an example in literary criticism, instruction, analysis, symbolism, or discussion of other works does not by itself establish adventure content of the described book. A mission, duty, objective, rescue, conflict, or requirement to set something right does not by itself establish an adventure-like progression; the supplied description must establish a quest/journey/expedition or an actual action-driven sequence of exploits rather than merely a goal that could involve such events. An explicit narrative quest, journey, or expedition establishes adventure-like progression unless the term is only meta-discussion or an example about another work. A concrete action-driving scenario can also establish progression when the supplied text itself states sustained hazardous action, such as taking up arms in a struggle/battle against an army, or being sent in pursuit of a dangerous target whose peril is explicitly described. This positive rule does not turn a bare mission, duty, rescue, conflict, or goal into adventure.

hard_exclusions.rule: A quest, journey, expedition, adventure, or hero journey used only as an example in literary criticism, instruction, analysis, symbolism, or discussion of other works does not establish adventure content of the described work.

required_components.definition: A quest, journey, expedition, or action-driven sequence of exploits involving challenge, discovery, or danger is established.
negative_boundaries: A static setting or isolated conflict without adventure-like progression is insufficient.
Adventure terms used only as literary-analysis examples/meta-discussion do not establish adventure content of the described work.

A mission, duty, objective, rescue, conflict, or requirement to set something right does not by itself establish a quest/journey or action-driven sequence of exploits. Do not infer unseen challenges, discoveries, dangers, or progression that the exact text merely could involve.

Positive clarification: an explicit narrative quest, journey, or expedition is sufficient progression unless it is only meta-discussion. Likewise, concrete sustained hazardous action explicitly stated in the description (for example taking up arms in a battle/army struggle, or being sent in pursuit of a dangerous target with stated peril) can establish an action-driven sequence. A bare mission/goal/conflict remains insufficient.

facets.semantic_definition: Myths, mythic traditions, mythological settings, or events and figures explicitly presented as rooted in mythology or as a retelling/reworking of myths. Generic fantasy creatures, magic, monsters, or supernatural events alone do not establish mythology. Discussion of mythology, mythic motifs, archetypes, or symbols only as analytical examples in literary criticism or instruction does not by itself make the described work a mythology recommendation. Scholarship, evidence, or analysis about the historical/ritual origin, source, provenance, or transmission of a legend does not by itself establish substantive mythology in the described work. Conversely, if the description explicitly says the narrative is based on or retells classical mythic/epic source material and itself depicts supernatural mythic figures, creatures, or events as story content, that is positive grounding for mythology; no outside knowledge is required. The classical-myth source/retelling signal and the supernatural mythic narrative-content signal may occur in different exact description spans; when both are present in the supplied description they may be composed deterministically for this component.

hard_exclusions.rule: Symbols, archetypes, communion, rain, quests, deeper meanings, or literary interpretation do not by themselves establish mythology or mythic traditions.
Discussion of mythology, mythic motifs, or symbolic examples in literary criticism or instruction does not by itself make the described work a mythology recommendation.

Research/evidence about where a legend originated, its ritual/historical source, or provenance is analytical/meta content; it does not establish mythology unless the description independently presents myths/mythic tradition or a retelling/reworking.

required_components.definition: Myths, mythic traditions/settings/events/figures, or an explicit retelling/reworking rooted in mythology are established. Explicit source/retelling language tied to classical mythic/epic material, combined with supernatural mythic narrative content in the supplied description, also satisfies this component.
negative_boundaries: Generic fantasy creatures, magic, monsters, or supernatural events alone do not establish mythology.
Analytical discussion of myths/motifs/archetypes as examples does not establish substantive mythology content.
A legend's historical/ritual origin or provenance being studied does not by itself establish a mythic or mythological basis.

facets.semantic_definition: Gods, goddesses, deities, or unmistakably divine beings. Powerful magical or supernatural beings are not automatically gods. Do not invent gods from symbols, communion, weather, natural phenomena, archetypes, or literary interpretation unless the supplied description itself states or necessarily entails a divine being. Meta-discussion of divine symbolism in literature is not the same as gods being substantive subject matter or narrative content of the described work.

hard_exclusions.rule: Symbols, communion, weather, rain, natural phenomena, archetypes, or literary interpretation do not by themselves establish gods, goddesses, deities, or divine beings.

required_components.definition: A god, goddess, deity, or unmistakably divine being is established by the supplied description.
negative_boundaries: Powerful magical/supernatural beings are not automatically gods.
Symbols, communion, weather, natural phenomena, archetypes, or literary interpretation do not establish a deity unless the description itself does.

facets.semantic_definition: Heroes explicitly presented as legendary, mythic, or belonging to legend, or unmistakably characterized as legendary heroic figures within the supplied description. A protagonist, warrior, adventurer, fictional hero, or brave character is not automatically a legendary hero. Literary-analysis examples or discussion of hero archetypes do not by themselves establish legendary heroes as substantive content of the described work. A fantasy-sounding place name, knighthood, a steed, a heroic mission, world-saving stakes, or participation in a quest does not make a hero legendary or mythic unless the supplied description itself explicitly or unmistakably establishes legendary/mythic identity. In analytical/provenance discussion, the phrase 'the legend of X' does not by itself identify X as a legendary hero; the description must actually establish heroic identity/content. Conversely, when the supplied description explicitly presents myths/legends as the work content and identifies them as stories of heroes (for example stories of gods and heroes), legendary/mythic hero identity is positively grounded unless the passage is only analytical origin/provenance discussion.

hard_exclusions.rule: A protagonist, fictional hero, warrior, adventurer, quest participant, or brave character is not automatically a legendary or mythic hero.
Literary-analysis examples or discussion of hero archetypes do not by themselves establish legendary heroes as substantive content of the described work.
The phrase 'legend of X' in scholarship about a legend's origin/history/provenance does not establish X as a legendary hero unless hero/heroic identity is independently stated.

required_components.definition: A hero is explicitly legendary/mythic/belonging to legend, or unmistakably characterized as a legendary heroic figure. Explicit work-content framing that presents myths/legends together with hero stories is sufficient semantic grounding for legendary/mythic hero identity when it is not merely provenance scholarship.
negative_boundaries: A protagonist, warrior, adventurer, fictional hero, or brave character is not automatically a legendary hero.
Hero-archetype discussion or literary-analysis examples do not establish substantive legendary-hero content.
Fantasy-sounding names or settings, knighthood, a steed, a heroic mission, world-saving stakes, or participation in a quest do not by themselves establish legendary/mythic hero identity.
A named figure appearing only in the phrase 'legend of X' within origin/provenance scholarship is not automatically a legendary hero.

queries.query: A thoughtful book about inequality, poverty, and how society distributes wealth

facets.semantic_definition: Social or economic inequality: unequal status, opportunity, income, wealth, resources, or material conditions across people, groups, or classes. Generic unfairness, injustice, unequal treatment in an individual case, or legal injustice alone does not establish the social/economic inequality intended by this query. Social-class labels or contrast (for example working class versus bourgeoisie) can provide inequality-adjacent presence, but when they function only as character/background description and the text does not develop unequal resources, income/wealth, opportunity, material conditions, or distribution, they should not receive substantive whole-work prominence.

required_components.definition: Unequal social/economic status, opportunity, income, wealth, resources, or material conditions across people, groups, or classes is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic unfairness, injustice, or unequal treatment in an individual case alone does not establish social/economic inequality.

Class labels/contrast alone, without an actual stated social/economic disparity in resources, status, opportunity, income, wealth, or material conditions, are insufficient for substantive inequality treatment.

facets.semantic_definition: Poverty or material deprivation, including inadequate income, resources, living conditions, or access to basic needs. Generic hardship, suffering, disadvantage, or injustice without material/economic deprivation does not establish poverty.

required_components.definition: Inadequate income, resources, living conditions, or access to basic needs—i.e. poverty/material deprivation—is established.
negative_boundaries: Generic hardship, suffering, disadvantage, or injustice without material/economic deprivation does not establish poverty.

facets.semantic_definition: How wealth, income, or economic resources are distributed across society, groups, or classes, including concentration, disparity, redistribution, or allocation of wealth. Wealth or poverty mentioned in isolation does not necessarily establish the distribution of wealth.

required_components.definition: The description addresses how wealth, income, or economic resources are distributed across society, groups, or classes, including concentration, disparity, redistribution, or allocation.
negative_boundaries: Wealth or poverty mentioned in isolation without a distribution/allocation relation does not establish wealth distribution.

facets.semantic_definition: A reflective, analytical, serious, nuanced, or considered treatment of the subject. Merely mentioning an important social topic does not by itself establish a thoughtful treatment.

required_components.definition: The treatment is reflective, analytical, serious, nuanced, or considered rather than merely mentioning the topic.
negative_boundaries: Merely mentioning an important social topic does not establish a thoughtful treatment.

development_evidence.basis: First 30-case v0.27 unseen validation run (now consumed development evidence) exposed four severe disagreements; this facet revision addresses only the Q01/Q02/Q05 semantic-boundary classes. Q07 is handled by a generic collection-scope prominence rule in the judge config.
changes: Preserves all facet decompositions and canonical component IDs from v0.9.5.

Q01/F2: generic despair/failure followed by renewed success, improvement, or greatness is not redemption unless the text grounds both a redemption-type damaged state and restoration/atonement of that state.
Q02/F1: action, battle, rebellion, betrayal, high stakes, danger, or a threatening antagonist do not by themselves establish suspense without story-level tension/anticipation about unfolding events.
Q05/F1: adds two independent grounding modes—actual warfare, or explicit war/warfare-as-subject analysis/history/strategy/causes/effects—while preserving the background-war guard.
Q07 facet semantics remain unchanged; only whole-book prominence scope for constituent items changes in the judge config.
Scoring, rubric, model, temperature, and final-holdout data remain unchanged.
